title: Risk Strategy
description: Payment risk control: blacklist blocking, geo-restriction, and hit logging.

riskEnabled.label: Risk Control Master Switch
riskEnabled.desc: When enabled, the payment flow performs risk checks; when disabled, all risk checks are skipped.

blacklistEnabled.label: Blacklist Blocking
blacklistEnabled.desc: When enabled, IP and user identifier (Alipay userId / WeChat openId) blacklist checks are performed.

riskBlockBeforePay.label: Block Order on Hit
riskBlockBeforePay.desc: When enabled, any risk-rule hit before payment (blacklist, province, overseas IP, etc.) will reject the order; when disabled, hits are only logged without blocking.

riskCheckAfterPay.label: Post-Pay Hit Logging
riskCheckAfterPay.desc: When enabled, hits are recorded after successful payment for post-event analysis, without affecting funds.

riskOpenIdLevel.label: User Identifier Interception Level
riskOpenIdLevel.desc: Normal: only block JSAPI/Mini native methods. Enhanced: also force OAuth to acquire user identifier for H5/QR-code in recognizable environments.

blockOverseasIp.label: Overseas IP Blocking
blockOverseasIp.desc: Block payment requests from overseas IPs (outside mainland China), a common risk control strategy for the China region.

regionBlacklistEnabled.label: Region Blocking
regionBlacklistEnabled.desc: When enabled, the IP’s province and city are matched against the region blacklists; hits follow the interception strategy. A province hit skips the city check. Manage province and city lists under Payment Security → Blacklist; for municipalities, the city list equals the province list.

ipv6MatchEnabled.label: IPv6 Region Matching
ipv6MatchEnabled.desc: Off by default. When enabled, all four regional checks (province, city, overseas, geo-fence) will match against IPv6 addresses. Due to limited accuracy of open-source IPv6 offline data, it is disabled by default; for higher reliability, consider a commercial IP database.
ipv6MatchEnabled.precisionHint: IPv6 offline data has limited accuracy; some address ranges may be located with significant deviation. For higher reliability, consider purchasing a commercial IP database (e.g. ip2region Pro, CZ88, etc.) to replace the default data source.

geoFenceEnabled.label: Geo-fence
geoFenceEnabled.desc: Store city-level geo-fence switch. When enabled, the client IP city is compared with the store's city; mismatches are handled per the block strategy. Stores must have a region address recorded; stores without an address are allowed (fail-open). After enabling the platform switch, the fence must also be enabled per merchant. The fence strategy is configured globally below.
